scope: Proposition 5.9 (The ordinary constants map) of the manuscript “The height-three chromatic overlap: an explicit filtration and its attachments” (preprints/The-height-three-chromatic-overlap-an-explicit-filtration-and-its-attachments-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 05577ee22db5cad1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 34. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For p ≥ 5, the structure map Y1 → BGf and the coefficient unit induce an equivalence RΓcts(Gf , R) ≃ − − → RΓ(Y1, O♭ ). This is an equivalence of derived algebras and is natural over S, with continuous profinite parameters. It retains both frame-group actions before taking their cohomology. In particular the degree-three class from the rank-two Tate frame is carried by this actual map from constants.
